study.question: Did common cart-donor initialization, the split first-affine implementation, or their interaction cause the previous equal-capacity control to lose click AUC, and can an initialization-preserving split remain admissible for further capacity/cost work?
study.hypothesis: The prior independent split control changed both auxiliary prefix starting values and split implementation. Since auxiliary context gradients stay attached, altered auxiliary starting values can change the shared context embedding trajectory and therefore click AUC even though auxiliary item/scorer gradients are blocked. Common initialization is an unverified explanation for a substantial part of the observed 0.0018691347012103 AUC loss. A 2x2 native/cart initialization by fused/split implementation comparison separates those interventions and their interaction at fixed capacity. BF16/Parameter-layout sensitivity is an explicit competing explanation. This diagnostic does not predict or claim a new efficient model, and cannot validate weight tying.

nearest_work.difference: Archived original primary text read at lines293-357, especially Dice batch statistics at317-335; existing baseline and candidate source inspected. Inherit local activation and Dice. This study changes auxiliary first-affine initialization/execution only; it is not an exact DIN reproduction or a priority claim.

Pinned benchmark reimplementation read at90-174: interacting sequence/categorical/task tokens and independent task towers. No hub mechanism is adopted. This local affine factorial has no token/hub replacement. Original INFNet paper was not fully inspected; benchmark source is not proof of equivalence.

Archived source and receipt inspected: every auxiliary common map copies the cart prefix before splitting, while reference starts with separate native task weights. Complete missing native-split and cart-fused cells; no novelty claim.

study.proposed_difference: Add exactly two missing factorial cells: (1) split each auxiliary first affine using its own native prefix instead of cart donor, with independent prefix/history Parameters; (2) keep original fused affines and copy cart prefix starting values into the independently owned fav/buy prefix slices. All biases, history slices, nonprefix weights and random draws are inherited. The four modules use identical total scalar capacity (expected32108245), four active tasks and loss. Parameter tensor structure is different only under splitting. No tied map or shared projection reuse is executed in this suite.
predictions: Reference and archived split-cart bridges should reproduce their prior fixed-seed click AUCs 0.6671249391761293 and0.665255804474919 within1e-6; this is a consistency check, not a repeated-seed experiment.

If the donor initialization explanation dominates, fused-cart will lose more than0.0002 AUC versus fused-native, while native-split stays within0.0002 of fused-native. This prediction is prospective for the new cells.

If split implementation dominates, both split contrasts will lose more than0.0002 AUC, including native-split. If both factors matter or interact, retain that result without forcing a single-factor explanation.

All four cells should have31793216 embedding and315029 dense parameters, total32108245. No capacity saving is predicted; native-split can only qualify as an execution candidate if cost is actually lower.

Auxiliary initialization can affect learned click behavior through shared context updates; the source predicts no direct initial click-forward change from donor copies. Exact mapped FP32 auxiliary equivalence across split/fused is mathematical, pending host numerical checks.
falsifiers: No material fused initialization contrast undermines the donor-only explanation. A large native split loss undermines preservation by fixing initialization.
A large factorial interaction prevents an additive initialization-versus-split explanation.
Wrong parameter counts, changed random draws outside the intended copy, masks, source-gradient ownership, task coverage or failed host checks invalidate the contrast before quality interpretation.
Failure of quality preservation or absence of measured prediction-cost improvement rejects efficiency promotion of native-split even if the diagnostic is informative.
A single fixed-seed result cannot establish a universal capacity requirement, a causal benefit of industry knowledge, or robust support for tying.
alternative_explanations: Two BF16 projections and addition have different rounding from one fused affine; task Dice batch moments can propagate small differences.
Separate Parameters change registration/contiguity and gradient reduction order; frozen AdamW/clipping may therefore take different finite-precision trajectories.
Common starting values alter auxiliary gradient directions into the attached shared context, not necessarily useful task specialization.
Task Dice statistics, one-pass optimization and adaptive selection at one seed may explain outcome differences.
Kernel dispatch, device load, allocator warmup and data loading affect time; source operation counts alone cannot establish efficiency.
Prior sharing and evaluation reuse experiments showed no clean measured inference benefit and substantial AUC loss. A corrected baseline does not rescue those mechanisms without new matched evidence.
